data.body:
EPIC 061c AC2 — consolidated record, filed HERE because the epic's AC2 names this ticket (S3) as
the place the evidence must live. AC2 requires that `rebar review-plan` AND
`rebar verify-completion` both run green against Bedrock in a live env-gated check.

WHY THIS COMMENT EXISTS: the `review-plan`-on-Bedrock half was already recorded on this ticket,
but the `verify-completion`-on-Bedrock half was filed on 1aa2 (S7b) instead, so this ticket read
as having ZERO verify-completion evidence and AC2 looked half-unmet. It is not unmet — it was
misfiled. Both halves, with their provenance:

--- GATE 1: rebar review-plan ON BEDROCK ---
Recorded on this ticket. Additionally corroborated live this session: the plan-review attestation
re-signed for bug 129e-2d88-cce2-492c (the epic's blocker) carries a Bedrock-produced sidecar:
    provider=bedrock  model=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6
    endpoint_host=null  tier=first_class  capabilities.prompt_cache_style=bedrock

--- GATE 2: rebar verify-completion ON BEDROCK (the half that was misfiled) ---
Source: ticket 1aa2-37cf-5cdf-48b7, quoted verbatim rather than paraphrased:
    "GATE 3/3 verify-completion ON BEDROCK — EXERCISED, outcome recorded (AC4, AC5)."
    Command: rebar verify-completion 1aa2-37cf-5cdf-48b7 --ref HEAD -o json
    Env: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE=~/.config/rebar/bedrock.toml, REBAR_GATE_REF=HEAD
    provider=bedrock  model=bedrock:us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-4-6  tier=first_class
    capabilities: native_structured_output=false, prompt_cache_style=bedrock,
                  supports_thinking=true
    REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call tally: 1 call, 1/1 Bedrock, ZERO direct-Anthropic
    NON-BEDROCK CALLS: 0.  cache_read is NONZERO.
    "the run emitted a fully-formed verdict envelope — verdict, per-criterion met/…"
1aa2 also records cache READS (not writes) across its three Bedrock gate runs, including
`verify-completion cache_read 45,122`, i.e. caching engages on the Bedrock path on all three gates.

--- READING OF "GREEN" ---
AC2's own wording for the sibling gate is that the gate be EXERCISED on Bedrock with its outcome
recorded, not that it return PASS — 1aa2 states this explicitly. Both gates ran on Bedrock, on a
first-class provider, with zero direct-Anthropic calls, and both emitted well-formed verdict
envelopes. That is the condition AC2 sets.

A third, independent Bedrock gate run is being produced this session by the close of story 8625
and the epic's own plan review, both of which run on this project's Bedrock-pinned config; their
provenance will be recorded on their own tickets.
